**Should this issue be sent to upstream instead?**
Bug reports should only be submitted here if they specifically relate to features JMusicBotUnlocked has implemented that are not present in [upstream](https://github.com/jagrosh/MusicBot/issues). Or, if upstream refuses to fix something and you have an argument for why Unlocked should.

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior.

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Operating system**
What kind of device is your bot running on? Include the operating system, version, and any other related information here.

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here.
